children: RNS Number : 1148U  HSBC Global Funds ICAV  09 September 2026

The Company today announces that the Interim Report for the financial period ended 30 June 2026 (the "Interim Report") has been published. A copy of the Interim Report has been submitted to the National Storage Mechanism and will shortly be available for inspection at https://data.fca.org.uk/#/nsm/nationalstoragemechanism and on the Company's website at www.assetmanagement.hsbc.com.
